supplementary.feed: community qlib dump — survivorship-biased (listed-only, no membership windows, normalised prices); reported only, never gated
supplementary.cost: flat 10.0bps/side (normalised price basis makes dollar-volume spread buckets meaningless)

live_config:
# Phase-8 pin (2026-11-17): B50_momvq selected by the
# predeclared walk-forward gate (configs/experiments/phase8_us.yaml).
# Walk-forward 2471d OOS IR
# +1.250 AR
# +0.278 mdd
# -0.316;
# gate passed=True match_frac=0.8
# worst_xs_year=-0.019221077293544164.
# `validated` is true only for a non-SPY winner that cleared every gate
# leg; the 100% SPY fallback is the benchmark itself — nothing to
# validate.
validated: true

# Live-trading interlock (NEVER set true here — see docs/BOT_SETUP.md).
live_trading: false

# Signal library for the sleeve. Computable live: mom, rev, srev5, mom6,
# lowvol, beta (Alpaca bars); vq, news (state/live snapshots); sn_* legs
# are sector-neutralised with the sector_map path below.
signals: [mom, vq]
weighting: equal          # signal blend inside the sleeve (equal ranks)
ic_months: 12
halflife_frac: 0.5

# Regime guard — on risk-off (SPY < SMA200 or top-decile trailing vol,
# lagged) the sleeve's freed share routes per sleeve.risk_off.
regime: none
regime_cfg:
  sma: 200
  vol_win: 21
  vol_lookback: 504
  vol_q: 0.90
  actions: {none: 1.0, half: 0.5, cash: 0.0, to_core: 0.0}

# Portfolio — core+satellite: 50% SPY core +
# 50% signal sleeve of up to 6 names (equal).
core: {symbol: SPY, weight: 0.5}
sleeve:
  n: 6
  weighting: equal
  risk_off: to_core
n_positions: 6          # legacy mirror of sleeve.n
budget_gbp: 10.0
cost_bps: 10.0            # sizing conservatism (paper fills are free)
rebalance_band: 0.02   # skip |dw| < band or < $1
snapshot_stale_days: 45
order_after_open_min: 15
sector_map: configs/benchmarks/assets/sp500_sector_map.csv
fwd_h: 21

risk:
  max_drawdown: 0.25          # equity vs running peak -> halt new buys
  daily_loss: 0.05            # equity vs prior day-summary -> halt buys
  max_position_weight: 0.2   # per single stock (SPY core exempt)
  max_orders: 12              # per run (sells kept, excess buys dropped)
  max_daily_notional_frac: 1.0
  max_price_move: 0.50
  min_universe: 100

universe: configs/live_universe.txt
